skills.name: Celestial Judgement​ (天誅)
skills.line: The king must charge before his men.
skills.description: Taishakuten burns out a sacred lotus to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Flawless Lotus (無垢蓮華)
skills.line: I know everything that's on your mind.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At start of Taishakuten's turn, if he is not immobile, he activates the Ceremony of the King field. ;Upon Usage :Taishakuten has a 100% base chance to inflict a single target with Golden Lotus, lasts for 1 turn. ;Golden Lotus (金蓮) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': The inflicted target's turn is manipulated by Taishakuten. Golden Lotus negates all control effects inflicted by a single skill for Taishakuten at the cost of 1 turn of the duration for Golden Lotus. When Taishakuten takes lethal damage, Golden Lotus will be removed, the damage dealt to him will be blocked and 5% of his max HP will be restored. When a monster inflicted with Golden Lotus receives damage, they'll receive an additional 40% of that damage as true damage. The true damage does not trigger Taishakuten's souls, and the effect lasts until the end of battle.
A max of 1 enemy can be marked at a single time and Taishakuten is immune to Golden Lotus. :''(Taishakuten also gains a separate Golden Lotus mark when inflicting it on non-monsters to represent how many control effects he can negate.)''

upgrades.text: Decreases initial ATK for the enemy inflicted with Golden Lotus by 80% on their own turn.
If the Ceremony of the King field isn't active, increases Taishakuten's move bar by 50% at the end of his turn.
If an enemy inflicted with Golden Lotus uses a normal attack, gain 1 onibi.
Duration of Golden Lotus increases to 2 turns and if it's inflicted on a monster, additional true damage equal to 70% of his ATK is inflicted.

skills.name: Ceremony of the King (王の盛宴)
skills.line: I shall deliver judgement upon this world!
skills.description:
While this field is active, decreases SPD for all allies by 3% for every enemy or onmyouji. At the start of an enemy's turn, the move bar for the ally at the top of the move bar is increased by 30%.
The field disappears when Taishakuten is KO'd.

skills.name: Instant Lotus Bloom (刹那蓮華綻放)
skills.line: This throne, built on flesh and blood, will only grow higher and higher.
skills.description: A myriad of lotuses instantly bloom, attacking all enemies dealing damage equal to 138% of Taishakuten's ATK. Also restores his own HP and the ally with the lowest HP by 100% of his ATK. ; :

upgrades.text: When Golden Lotus disappears, all control effects on Taishakuten are removed and this skill is activated once without using onibi (this attack will not trigger enemy passives or souls, but damage and restored HP is reduced by 40%).

bio.condition: In PVN zones, successfully control the turn of an enemy with Golden Lotus 99 times.
